identificationModule.briefTitle: Study of Orelabrutinib in Combination With Gemox in Refractory / Relapsed Diffuse Large B-cell Lymphoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II, Prospective, Multicenter Study Ofrelabrutinib in Combination With Gemox in Refractory / Relapsed Diffuse Large B-cell Lymphoma

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study aims to investigate the treatment of refractory or relapsed DLBCL with orelabrutinib and gemox. The primary endpoint is response rate (complete response rate and overall response rate), and the second endpoints are survival time (OS and PFS) and toxicities.

interventions.name: Orelabrutinib and Gemox
interventions.description:
Drug: Orelabrutinib Orelabrutinib 200mg, po, qd

Drug: Gemox14 Gemcitabine, Oxaliplatin

primaryOutcomes.description: overall response rate after treated by Orelabrutin and Gemox
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 12 weeks after the initiation of the treatment

secondaryOutcomes.description: PFS was defined as time from study registration to first disease progression or death whichever occurred first, otherwise subject data were censored at time last known disease free
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to two years after the start of the study

secondaryOutcomes.description: OS was defined as time from study registration to death, and otherwise censored at time last known alive
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to two years after the start of the study

secondaryOutcomes.description: The time from the first assessment of CR or PR to PD (progressive disease) or death from any cause
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to three years after the start of the study

secondaryOutcomes.description: All the adverse events of the patients related will be assessed and graded by NCI CTCAE v5.0
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to one year after the start of the study

locations.facility: The Second Affiliated Hospital of Kunming Medical University
